importPolicy.existingRecords: Resolve known metric/objective IDs; resolve position titles to existing IDs before insertion. Stop on ambiguity. Do not replace unrelated records or permissions.

importPolicy.formulas: Manually entered values and manually maintained status; formulas are documentation only.

importPolicy.strategyLinks: Internal IDs are retained for references. Display titles have no numerical prefixes. Proposed strategy links require review.
importPolicy.q4: No Q4 objective table supplied; Q4-related due dates remain on the source-quarter objective.
importPolicy.q1q2: Immutable historical notes served only through the Admin data table archive. Excluded from active objectives, metric actuals, rollups and scoring.

kpiDefinitions.name: Resident Experience Score
kpiDefinitions.definition: To measure how supported, connected, and empowered residents feel throughout their housing journey, and how these experiences contribute to overall housing stability.
kpiDefinitions.formula:
Blended score for housing stability rate, average housing tenure; positive move-outs, and resident satisfaction. 
Housing Stability Rate:	% of households with no eviction  / involuntary exits (10% weight)
Average Housing Tenure: Avg. length of stay (seniors 7+, families 5+)	(10% weight)
Positive Move-Out Rate: % of move-outs that are planned, stable, upward (30% weight); Resident Satisfaction (50%)

calculation.sourceFormula:
Blended score for housing stability rate, average housing tenure; positive move-outs, and resident satisfaction. 
Housing Stability Rate:	% of households with no eviction  / involuntary exits (10% weight)
Average Housing Tenure: Avg. length of stay (seniors 7+, families 5+)	(10% weight)
Positive Move-Out Rate: % of move-outs that are planned, stable, upward (30% weight); Resident Satisfaction (50%)

kpiDefinitions.name: Positive Move-Out Rate
kpiDefinitions.definition: Move-outs that are planned, stable and upward.
kpiDefinitions.formula:
Positive: Move to unsubsidized or market-rate housing due to increased income; Purchase of a home,
Move to a location with better access to jobs, education, or supports; assisted living, health concerns, relocating
Negative: Nonrenewal; eviction; homeslessness or unstable housing; unsatisfied with property
Neutral: Death

calculation.sourceFormula:
Positive: Move to unsubsidized or market-rate housing due to increased income; Purchase of a home,
Move to a location with better access to jobs, education, or supports; assisted living, health concerns, relocating
Negative: Nonrenewal; eviction; homeslessness or unstable housing; unsatisfied with property
Neutral: Death
